title: Welcome to the Future of DE&I: A Conversation Exploring Progressive Practices
teaser: Join Korn Ferry and Workhuman as we explore data-backed insights into how to foster diversity that is truly equitable and inclusivity that lasts the long term.
bodyText:
DE&I is increasingly important for both companies and employees. But after one-time trainings and reexamined hiring practices, how do you foster diversity that is truly equitable and inclusivity that lasts the long term?

Korn Ferry connected with over 1,700 business leaders, DE&I professionals, and HR experts from across North America on their experience with DE&I strategies. Join us for an urgent and candid conversation with data-backed insights into what organizations need to do differently to make real progress on DE&I as we move into the future. Together we’ll discuss: The most common DE&I initiatives organizations have focused on and, based on recent case studies, what worked and what was missing How to define success in DE&I The biggest implementation challenges organizations encounter

bodyText: ERGs have long been seen as culture-building communities, but leading organizations are proving they can be powerful catalysts for engagement, leadership development, and belonging. The key? Aligning your recognition and ERG strategies.  When recognition is intentionally woven into ERGs, organizations amplify their impact—strengthening belonging and reinforcing a culture of appreciation. This session will explore how recognition and strategic alignment can elevate ERGs into culture-driving forces that shape the employee experience.  Learn to:  Maximize your recognition ROI by aligning your recognition program with your ERG initiatives.  Align ERGs with leadership development and organizational culture strategies.  Measure and showcase ERG impact to strengthen recognition ROI.  How to build a framework that positions ERGs as integral to a thriving workplace culture.

title: New Insights from Gallup to Leverage Recognition and Transform Culture
teaser: Gallup recently partnered with Workhuman® to explore how organizations across the U.S and Western Europe are using recognition to create human-centered workplaces and reap strategic business benefits.
bodyText:
Gallup recently partnered with Workhuman ®  to explore how organizations across the United States and Western Europe are using recognition to create human-centered workplaces and reap strategic business benefits like improved engagement and retention.

Among key results, the research found that employees who received the right amount of recognition were 70% less likely to be burned out and 56% less likely to be seeking job opportunities.

Gallup’s Ed O’Boyle and Workhuman’s Corinne Selk explore key findings with data-backed insights and real-world examples about what organizations need to be doing to build a culture of recognition where all employees can thrive and do their best work. Together we’ll discuss: The value of recognition and its impact on engagement, connection, culture, and retention Actionable steps to help managers and organizations unleash the full potential of recognition The five pillars of recognition identified in the Gallup-Workhuman research and the framework they provide to meet the needs of today’s employees

title: The ROI of Strategic Employee Recognition: By the Numbers
teaser: Research shows that a strong culture of recognition is critical to an organization’s overall success. How can HR professionals make a compelling business case to senior leaders? It starts with data.
bodyText:
Research shows that a strong culture of recognition is critical to an organization’s overall success. But in a turbulent global economy – with increased budget scrutiny – how can HR professionals make a compelling business case to senior leaders?  It starts with data. 

According to recent Gallup research, nearly half (46%) of senior leaders don’t know what percentage of their budget is allocated to recognition – and 10% don’t know whether the organization even has an allocated recognition budget!

Get the tools and insights that you need to have informed, data-driven discussions about the business rationale for a strategic investment in recognition with senior leadership. During this session, you’ll learn: Analytics and outcomes of well-designed strategic recognition programs Ways to model financial returns against productivity, retention, health and safety, and absenteeism through the ROI calculator tool How to evaluate your employee recognition and total rewards strategy

title: Unlock the Skills-Powered Organization With Recognition Data
teaser:
Traditional skill appraisal methods—self-reported assessments and manager evaluations—are often incomplete and unreliable, limiting organizations' ability to leverage the benefits of their talent investments. This session, based on Mercer’s latest research, explores how recognition data becomes an invaluable source of data to identify and confirm skills—providing a real-time, validated view of how skills are currently used within an organization, and mitigating bias that can emerge through other means of skills identification. Learn how effective recognition can uncover hidden talent, reduce bias in hiring and promotions, and align workforce development with business goals. 

In this session you will learn: 

Why skills-powered organizations outperform their peers and how to align recognition with talent development strategies. 

How to leverage recognition data to organically uncover and confirm employee skills accurately, in real time. 

How to design meaningful recognition programs that deliver skills-rich data, the key to uncovering hidden potential and supporting business growth.

The workplace is in the midst of unprecedented disruption. What is the best way for HR leaders to chart a course forward? Which areas should receive the most focus?

Join us as we discuss the key trends driving the future of work, but also explore the strategies you need to create a human-centered, high-performing work culture. You will learn: Tips for creating a hybrid, agile, and interdependent workplace How to evolve processes to build loyalty and create a positive workplace culture The ways DE&I will grow as differentiators for recruiting and retention The consequences of the Great Resignation and how companies can turn the outcomes into the Great Reshuffle

title: From Moment to Movement: The Keys to Creating an Effective DE&I Strategy
teaser: During this webinar, Meisha-ann Martin along with Sarah Morgan will explore and discuss the many facets of an effective DE&I strategy that can position your organization for long-term success
bodyText: The past year has opened a door to many opportunities in diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I). How is your organization leveraging these opportunities to move beyond this promising beginning? How can you create a human workplace that truly allows every employee to feel valued and included? During this webinar, Meisha-ann Martin, Director of People Analytics at Workhuman, along with Sarah Morgan, CEO of BuzzARooney LLC, will explore and discuss the many facets of an effective DE&I strategy that can position your organization for long-term success in an evolving world. Tune into this webinar to learn: How DE&I impacts recruitment, engagement, performance, and retention Why and how to conduct a diversity audit that reveals where bias and inequity hide The role of recognition data and other actionable tips for creating an effective  DE&I strategy

title: From Surviving to Thriving: Promoting Wellbeing and Combating Burnout in the Workplace
teaser: Join Siobhan Murray, leading burnout expert, and Dr. Isha Vicaria, senior research and people data analyst at Workhuman, for a discussion on burnout in the workplace and how leaders can prevent it.
bodyText: Burnout costs $322 billion globally in turnover and lost productivity. Based on a recent Workhuman study, burnt-out workers have trouble focusing, are more likely to make mistakes, and are physically exhausted. How can organizations step up to support their employees and create a healthy culture? Join Siobhan Murray, leading burnout expert, and Dr. Isha Vicaria, senior research and people data analyst at Workhuman, for a timely discussion on burnout in the workplace and what steps leaders can take to recognize and prevent it. You’ll learn: Actionable wellbeing strategies and takeaways to implement immediately How HR leaders can save the losses resulting from voluntary turnover from burnout How low-cost recognition can improve employees’ lives

title: Gallup Research Debut: Driving Workplace Culture by Leveraging Recognition
teaser: Get data-backed strategies from Gallup that every leader can use to transform their work culture by leveraging recognition.
bodyText:
An organization is only as strong as its work culture. In fact, human talent is worth 2.33X more than any physical or technological asset. But with employees feeling more disengaged from their work today than they have in a decade, companies must ask themselves: What can we do to foster a culture of connection across the organization?

This webinar will share the latest research findings from Gallup and Workhuman on the ways employee recognition can support building a culture of connection and affect key business outcomes such as engagement, productivity, and attrition. You’ll also gain data-backed strategies to help lead a cultural transformation at your company.

Plus, join the live webinar and earn 1 PDC toward SHRM-CP or SHRM-SCP recertification.
 You’ll learn: Evidence-based insights from Gallup on how employee recognition can improve business-critical elements of your workplace culture Which elements of recognition can predict how employees experience culture, such as a sense of belonging, job satisfaction, engagement, growth, wellness, and purpose Strategies to energize your workforce by improving the ways employees get work done and interact with each other

title: Gallup Research on the Power of Recognition: A Toolkit to Impact Behavior Shifts
teaser: Watch Gallup and Workhuman discuss the link between employee behaviors and business performance, and how elevating your recognition strategy leads to greater business results.
bodyText: In this webinar, Ed O'Boyle and Greg Stevens discuss the link between employee behaviors and business performance, and how elevating your recognition strategy leads to greater business results.   Key takeaways from this session include:   Science-based evidence from Gallup showing how recognition translates to behavioral shifts that result in a more engaged, motivated workforce and improved job performance.   The different types of intrinsic and extrinsic value that motivate employees, and how organizations can effectively tailor them for the greatest impact.  Best practices for recognition programs that lead to ROI, and how leaders from different organizations can apply these strategies to effectively reinforce behavioral shifts.   Defining and measuring success of recognition reward programs – common methods and challenges of evaluating recognition-related ROI, and how organizations can adapt these principles for their own use.

title: How Baystate Health Is Building a People-First Culture
teaser: Hear how Baystate Health is leveraging its recognition program and taking innovative approaches to DE&I
bodyText: A great employee experience creates a great customer experience. Hear how Baystate Health is leveraging its recognition program and taking innovative approaches to DE&I to strengthen their  people-first culture  and improve the experiences of the patients they serve.

title: How Prioritizing Wellbeing Drives Employee Engagement: GoTo's Story
teaser: Christine Grant, staff compensation analyst at GoTo, and Lauren Spencer, senior consultant at Workhuman, explore how GoTo implemented recognition to promote wellbeing and spark cultural transformation.
bodyText: Workplaces that prioritize wellbeing see employees who are more engaged and productive. But what are the best ways to amplify wellbeing among today’s on-site, hybrid, and remote employees? Join Christine Grant, staff compensation analyst at GoTo, and Lauren Spencer, senior consultant at Workhuman, as they explore how GoTo implemented recognition to promote wellbeing and spark cultural transformation. Tactical ways to create a positive, collaborative culture in a flexibility-first world How GoTo is using team member recognition to fuel wellbeing and engagement The latest research about strategic recognition and burnout The importance of aligning recognition with company values to maximize business impacts

title: How to Be a Diversity and Inclusion Ambassador
teaser: Explore how everyone in your organization across all levels can play a pivotal role in creating a diverse and welcoming workplace with author Celeste Warren and SHRM.
bodyText: Join Celeste Warren, author of the new book, “How to Be a Diversity and Inclusion Ambassador,” as she explains how everyone from C-suite leaders to frontline employees can play a pivotal role in creating a diverse and welcoming workplace.

title: How to Boost Morale and Community: Merck's Story
teaser: If remote work is our new normal, what are successful HR leaders doing to lift morale and keep their employees connected and engaged?
bodyText: If remote work is our new normal, what are successful HR leaders doing to lift morale and keep their employees connected and engaged? Merck, one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in the world, knows that doubling down on gratitude and appreciation is a proven way to build and sustain human connections vital to helping businesses thrive. Watch this webinar to learn about: How peer-to-peer recognition keeps employees connected and engaged in a virtual workplace The impact of frequent recognition on engagement and community How Merck is aligning its recognition program to new ways of working Check out our  webinar recap here .

title: How to Build a Culture of Gratitude
teaser: For many companies, gratitude is the secret ingredient that makes teamwork and camaraderie possible.
bodyText: For many companies, gratitude is the secret ingredient that makes teamwork and camaraderie possible. It lays a foundation of organizational positivity and social connection, boosts well-being and resilience, and is proven to impact culture, retention, and engagement. In this webinar, Workhuman data scientist Alan Medinger and HR business partner Sharon Pollard share key tips for building a culture of gratitude. Using real examples and results from Workhuman data and customers, they’ll show you how gratitude can be built into every organizational process that involves people – social recognition, performance management, service milestones, life events, and beyond. This webinar will provide: Data explaining why individuals and organizations need more gratitude Success stories from companies like yours that have made gratitude a cultural priority Practical tips for people managers to infuse their teams with positivity and connection

title: How to Build a Radically Candid Culture of Feedback
teaser: Kim Scott, author of the New York Times bestseller Radical Candor, and Rosette Cataldo, Workhuman® VP of Performance & Talent Strategy, explore a human-centric performance development culture.
bodyText:
Data shows that most employees want more feedback. After all, consistent, ongoing feedback accelerates employee development and improves performance. But many organizations are finding it difficult to create a "culture of feedback," especially in today's hybrid work environments.

Join the feedback expert, Kim Scott, author of the New York Times bestseller Radical Candor, and Rosette Cataldo, Workhuman ®  Vice President of Performance and Talent Strategy, as they explore what it takes to create a human-centric performance development culture that's rooted in feedback. You will learn: How leading organizations are driving innovation, inclusion, and growth through feedback What you can expect when you start your journey to transform into a culture of feedback The skillset, toolset, and mindset needed to develop a culture of feedback Why it’s imperative to adopt the new management philosophy of “Caring Personally While Challenging Directly”

title: How to Create a Connected & Engaged Culture: GLG's Story
teaser: Tune into this webinar to learn how GLG, a leading platform connecting professionals to expertise, kept their people empowered through change, and built a lasting culture of appreciation.
bodyText: Boosting employee morale is a critical component of fueling engagement during challenging times. Tune into this webinar to learn how GLG, a leading platform connecting professionals to expertise, kept their people empowered through change, and built a lasting culture of positivity and appreciation.

title: How to Create a Connected and Engaged Culture: Rocket Central's Story
teaser: Niamh Graham, SVP Global Human Experience at Workhuman and Ashley Attaway, VP, People Experience and Support at Rocket Central, explore how Rocket Central is driving connection and engagement.
bodyText:
A positive work culture is key to attracting and retaining talent. But what are the best ways to create and maintain positive team member experiences, especially in today’s hybrid environments? Are there specific approaches that have proven effective?

Join Niamh Graham, SVP Global Human Experience at Workhuman and Ashley Attaway, Vice President, People Experience and Support at Rocket Central, as they explore how Rocket Central is driving connection and engagement in “the future of work.” You will learn: Tactical ways to keep team members connected in a hybrid workplace The role community involvement and physical office spaces play, even with a virtual-first mentality How Rocket Central is using team member recognition to fuel engagement, productivity, and retention

title: How to Create a Connected Culture Rich in Human Work Experiences
bodyText:
HR teams are challenged to build more inclusive workplaces, improve engagement, and mitigate turnover – all while adapting to new work environments. To succeed, HR pros must be more innovative and strategic than ever before. But does your team know how to harness the power of human connection? Can employee recognition help you meet your goals?

On World Gratitude Day, September 21, Workhuman explored HR’s critical role as a beacon of connected culture and more positive – and human – work experiences. Watch to learn: How small, everyday moments of gratitude can positively impact culture and create a bridge to inclusion and belonging  Practical ways HR teams can inspire connection and truly put people first How leading organizations are using recognition to drive innovation, inclusion, and growth

title: How to Drive DEI with Appreciation: Findings from Gallup
teaser: Watch this webinar to get Gallup's evidence-based insights about elevating DEI initiatives through recognition while buffering against burnout and turnover.
bodyText:
Despite investing in DEI initiatives, companies continue to struggle with retaining talent and creating truly inclusive workplace environments. Too often, it’s because they’ve treated DEI like a checkbox, missing the opportunity to foster diversity and connect with talent that can bring new perspectives to their business.

Watch this webinar to learn how to better shape DEI initiatives that create a culture that celebrates collective differences and a workplace where people of all backgrounds thrive. We’ll discuss: Findings from the new Gallup and Workhuman research into the connection between strategic employee recognition and DEI Evidence-based insights about elevating DEI initiatives through recognition while buffering against burnout and turnover Strategies every leader can use to energize, engage, and retain talent through a greater appreciation of what makes every employee unique

title: How To Implement Wellbeing as a Strategic Priority With Gallup
teaser: Hear from Gallup and Workhuman® leaders about the power of a customized wellbeing program. Find out how program performance metrics can help you increase employee satisfaction while realizing positive business impacts.
bodyText: Transforming workplace cultures through strategic wellbeing initiatives can lead to large-scale organizational success. By customizing wellbeing programs to your workplace and implementing effective methods to track program performance, organizations can increase the positive business impact of employee satisfaction.   Hear from Ed O’Boyle, Gallup Global Practice Leader and Ralph Meyer, Workhuman Senior Strategic Consultant for a session of actionable insights that include:   Practical strategies and a roadmap to foster a culture of wellbeing by initiating and sustaining effective wellbeing programs.   Essential steps to integrate wellbeing into total rewards strategies and tailor programs to your workplace dynamics.  A deepened understanding of how to lead organizational diagnostics, based on Gallup's latest research about global CHRO and U.S. employee perspectives on wellbeing initiatives.

title: How to Increase Engagement and Improve Work Culture: CAA's Story
teaser: CAA VP of Corporate Communications Tony Tsai and VP of Total Rewards Mara Notarfonzo, along with Workhuman’s David Stott, discuss proven ways you can incorporate recognition into your organization.
bodyText:
Revitalizing employee engagement doesn’t have to be a huge, complex program. The key is to take steps that are strategic, so you can start realizing business benefits right away. Employee engagement rock star, the Canadian Automobile Association (CAA), can show you how.

For the past six years, CAA has used employee recognition to unite and engage a diverse and highly distributed workforce. Last year, the company’s turnover was the lowest over a three-year period.

Hear from CAA VP of Corporate Communications Tony Tsai and VP of Total Rewards Mara Notarfonzo, along with Workhuman’s David Stott, as we discuss proven ways you can incorporate recognition into your organization and use it as a strategic lever. Join us and learn: The latest research into why employee recognition is needed now more than ever How CAA uses employee recognition to enhance and support onboarding, culture, and change management initiatives The significant impacts resulting from frequent recognition, including increased retention

title: How to Transform Today's DEI Practices: A Case Study from BLK Men in Tech
teaser: Join BLK Men in Tech and Workhuman as they examine the key factors that continue to perpetuate less positive work experiences for people of color.
bodyText:
Momentum has shifted significantly in recent years, urging the modern-day workforce to push for more diverse, equitable, and inclusive people practices and office environments. Yet, despite the widespread prioritization of DEI initiatives, new Workhuman ®  research conducted in partnership with BLK Men in Tech suggests these efforts are still missing the mark.

 Watch this webinar webinar to explore: Key factors that continue to perpetuate less positive workplace experiences for people of color and their psychological significance The connection between recognition and diverse, equitable people practices Actionable steps to begin narrowing the equity divide and transform people practices

You'll learn how AI tools trained on authentic, human data - a combination we call "Human Intelligence™"- can be used to gain deeper insight into your workforce and unlock peak employee performance.

title: HR Leaders Workshop - Find Hidden Spend, and Re-invest to Drive Measurable ROI
teaser: Whether you have a formal recognition program or not, your company is spending money to try and engage employees. Whether it is team drinks or well-intentioned small awards from managers, most companies are spending. The challenge is: they don’t know how much. They don’t know if they are spending on the right things and they have no way of measuring the impact. Join us to learn: where to look for spend, questions to ask and actions to take.
bodyText:
Whether you have formal culture/recognition programmes or not, your company is spending money trying to engage and retain key talent. Team or birthday drinks, well-intentioned awards from managers, and informal celebrations all add up. The questions is: how much do we really spend, and is it actually driving the outcomes our business needs?

 In this 30-minute workshop, we will: Provide context on where well-intentioned efforts may be backfiring. Run an exercise to show you how to quantify your existing investment to give yourself a benchmark to work from. Equip you with preliminary data and a structure to carry out a more complete analysis internally. At the end of this session you'll be ready to move forwards with more clarity on engagement spend – and turn good intentions into real results.
 Your Host:  Clare Moncrieff - Senior Principal Consultant, Workhuman  Clare Moncrieff is a seasoned professional with over 25 years of experience in HR and Professional Services. In her current role at Workhuman, Clare works helps people understand the true power of recognition to drive people and business success.  Prior to joining Workhuman, Clare was a Senior Director at TalentNeuron, a leader in labour market intelligence. She helped to launch their consulting practice and provided client advice. Before that, she was VP, People Director at Nokia and VP, Executive Advisor at Gartner. Clare began her HR career in earnest at Nortel, in Canada, where she worked in M,A+D, Exec Comp, and HRBP roles, before joining CEB (now Gartner) in the UK. Clare holds a honsBA in Psychology from York University in Toronto, and an MSc in Human Resources from the LSE in London. She lives in London and enjoys hiking.

title: HR Myth Busting: Secrets to Supercharge Workplace Culture
teaser: Join to hear our experts debunk and dismantle some common HR myths with actual research and data. You'll leave this webinar with key insights and the tools to support and enhance your company culture.
bodyText:
“People don’t leave jobs – they leave bad managers.” “Older, tenured employees don’t need check-ins.” “Good check-ins are better than frequent check-ins.” “Caregivers are more likely to leave the workforce.” After hearing statements like these so many times, you may just accept them as facts. But where’s the data proving any of them are true? Are we letting these commonly heard, unproven “facts” give toxic work cultures a pass? Hear our experts debunk and dismantle some common HR myths with actual research and data. You’ll leave this webinar with key insights and the tools to support and enhance your company culture.
You’ll learn: Which commonly held HR beliefs are myths and can lead to toxic work cultures How to create effective check-ins that positively impact the employee experience How recognition supports successful feedback systems and cultivates strong company cultures
